name: MCW Midwestern Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The promotion's top singles title, decided by an eight-man tournament that crowned its first champion at the promotion's own April 1999 pay-per-view.

name: MCW Television Championship
epitaph: A title the record picks up already in progress, its holder wagering his own freedom on a title defense before the belt later resurfaces on a different champion.

name: MCW Light Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: A title held by an Australian, second-generation wrestler whose April 1999 defense ended in an interference-marred finish with no result declared on air.

name: MCW Midwestern Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The promotion's tag title, awarded to the winner of a round-robin tournament settled at its own April 1999 pay-per-view.

name: MCW Gladiator Title
epitaph: A hardcore-styled title whose every defense is a gimmick match; the record picks it up already in progress by August 1999.
